content: {"tax_bps":200,"endowment_share":60,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":0,"minutes":"Locker_share is already at its constitutional maximum of 25, so the petitions' request is granted in spirit but clamped by the contract. Lockers are well paid relative to the pool. The real problem is the buyback fund: 0.07 NEAR cannot fund even 1 bp of burn (~9.5k CHAIR vs 135M supply), so buyback_burn is 0 this meeting. To rebuild it I shift 10 points from endowment (which already holds 13.7 NEAR, ample for inference) to the buyback share, and raise tax_bps by 50 to 200 since sell volume (44.6 NEAR) outpaces buys (31.5) and a firmer tax dampens churn while refilling the fund. All moves within 50/10 limits.","answers":["Locker_share is at the constitutional cap of 25 and cannot move higher; the contract would clamp any increase. You are receiving the maximum share already.","Agreed lockers deserve support, but 25 is the hard ceiling. Instead I shifted endowment share down to 60, leaving the locker share untouched at its max.","Pay the lockers we do — at 25%, the maximum allowed. Any petitioned increase beyond that is clamped and never applied. Consider locker_weight growth as the lever you control."]}
